title: Which fixes will improve the end of page morph ?

messages.text: Which fixes will improve the end of page morph ?

The biggest remaining win for the end-of-page morph is the end-screen background images; 3 smaller fixes join the v9.2 build.
- Already in today's best build: morph on the graphics chip, top bar stops following past the end, lighter panel push, no pin jump, countdown repaints cut.
- Next build (v9.2, freeze 15:00Z UTC), if their checks pass: the morph's close step (g11) and skipping phone-off scroll work (v9.1d).
- Also for v9.2: the countdown roll on the graphics chip (P-097) and the nav colour without a per-frame hit test (P-138).
- Biggest lever: on the phone, runs with the end-screen background images had 14-30 slow frames (over 34 ms); runs without had 2-5 (P-137).
- Images change the look, so fix-end-bg brings a proposal with Try-it pages around 16:00Z; you pick an option.
- Still being traced: a leftover stutter at the menu edge during the morph (fix-nav-morph); no fix yet.

What you need to do: nothing now. Try the image proposal when it reaches your console.
